trust_decision.summary: Decided in the async DEFLATE decompression path: bytes taken from an untrusted archive (central-directory method/size and payload, headers/entryHeader.js:260-268, zipEntry.js:27-28) may feed a zlib InflateRaw stream, and every failure of that stream must be delivered to the caller's callback (empty buffer + err) instead of being emitted as an unhandled 'error' event, while a CRC mismatch must keep returning the decoded buffer alongside BAD_CRC.

landing_point.why: The report says 'async DEFLATE decompression'; decompress()'s async branch is the only call site of inflateAsync, and an engineer searching for the async path lands here (or one hop away at methods/inflater.js:13, where the zlib stream without an 'error' listener is created).

fix_sites.entry_point: AdmZip#readFileAsync (adm-zip.js:157), AdmZip#readAsTextAsync (adm-zip.js:192), AdmZip#extractAllToAsync (adm-zip.js:813), ZipEntry#getDataAsync (zipEntry.js:309) - all reach inflateAsync through zipEntry.js:110
fix_sites.module_kind: low-level zlib wrapper (methods/inflater.js, published as adm-zip/methods)
decompression handler in the root package module

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can dismiss everything except the one DEFLATE stream-error event: an unknown compression method or a password-protected entry is an 'unsupported combination' the caller should not pass, the synchronous read API is documented (and tested) to throw, and the write-side deflate stream only ever sees data the application itself supplied.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A CRC mismatch on the async path must still hand the decoded buffer to the callback together with BAD_CRC (callback(result, err)); only a stream failure returns the empty placeholder. An over-broad fix that funnels every async failure through callback(Buffer.alloc(0), err) (or through one generic error) breaks this contract. Likewise the sync path must keep throwing BAD_CRC for a bad CRC rather than returning an empty buffer (test/crc/index.js:65-81, test/decompress_bomb.test.js:84).

O6_input_shapes: malformed DEFLATE payload: zlib emits 'error' (Z_DATA_ERROR) before 'end', no 'data' chunks or a partial prefix
well-formed DEFLATE whose output exceeds the declared central-directory size: maxOutputLength cap (inflater.js:5) produces ERR_BUFFER_TOO_LARGE as an 'error' event
'error' arriving after some 'data' chunks, plus the error-then-end ordering, so the callback must fire exactly once (done flag)
async call made without a callback function (inflater.js:21-29 guards with callback &&, zipEntry.js:111 guards with if (!callback))

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Unknown compression method: decompress() calls callback(Buffer.alloc(0), UNKNOWN_METHOD()) and then throws; when reached from the async chain (extractAllToAsync's reduce continuation runs inside a previous zlib 'end' callback) that throw is an uncaught exception that kills the process, with no error listener and no try/catch on the path.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: An unsupported compression method is a different defect from malformed-DEFLATE stream errors; the callback already received UNKNOWN_METHOD, so the failure is 'reported'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 11 lines below the fixed branch

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Encrypted entry with no / non-string password: decompress() throws INVALID_PASS_PARAM, and ZipCrypto.decrypt throws WRONG_PASSWORD (methods/zipcrypto.js:128); both escape synchronously into the async caller and become an uncaught exception for any entry after the first in the extractAllToAsync chain (that continuation runs inside a previous zlib 'end' callback).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Encryption is a neighbouring feature the caller opts into by supplying a password; a missing password is caller misuse, not archive-driven decompression failure.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function, ~35 lines above the fixed branch

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Synchronous decompression of a malformed DEFLATE payload via getData()/inflateRawSync (readFile, readAsText, extractEntryTo, extractAllTo, test) throws ERR_Z_DATA_ERROR from inflater.js:9 with no handling at zipEntry.js:103-107.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Sync APIs are documented and tested to throw (test/crc/index.js:65-81, test/decompress_bomb.test.js:84); a caller can try/catch, so the throw is not the uncatchable error event the advisory describes.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one file (methods/inflater.js:8-10), same function's sync branch

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Write-side async DEFLATE: deflateAsync creates a zlib DeflateRaw stream with 'data' and 'end' listeners only; the try/catch in zipFile.js:371 cannot catch an error raised later from its async callback (zipFile.js:391-414), so an 'error' event is uncaught - the exact mirror of the fixed defect.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The compressor only sees data the application supplied via addFile/updateFile, never archive bytes; the advisory's property covers decompression of untrusted input.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one directory sibling, 2 files from the landing point (methods/deflater.js vs zipEntry.js)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second async writer (e.g. a streaming zip writer) that reuses compress2Buffer and relies on the surrounding try/catch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: toAsyncBuffer already has a try/catch at line 371 that reads as protection but cannot cover errors thrown from the asynchronous getCompressedDataAsync callback; a maintainer copying this shape would reproduce the same blind spot.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another async fs helper (read/copy/move) that reports failures through a boolean callback and drops or re-throws the underlying fs error.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: writeFileToAsync's comments at lines 117-123 and 144-147 show this exact bug class was fixed here twice (issues #470, #402); a new sibling helper written the same way is entirely in character for this codebase.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An addLocalFileAsync-style promise/stream variant using fs.createReadStream, where a stream 'error' event has no handler.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The public API already mixes callback, Promise and stream-ish helpers (addLocalFileAsync, addLocalFolderPromise, writeZipPromise, toBufferPromise), so a stream-based read helper with the same missing 'error' listener is a natural addition.

O9_family: CWE-248 uncaught exception / CWE-400 uncontrolled resource consumption in archive decompression

O10_build.toolchain: npm + mocha 12 beta, chai, prettier (devDependencies only; no build step, CommonJS main adm-zip.js)
O10_build.project_tests: mocha suite under test/; for this area test/crc/index.js (async BAD_CRC callback, sync BAD_CRC throw), test/decompress_bomb.test.js (sync inflate of bogus DEFLATE, declared-size bomb), test/methods/methods.test.js:139-202 (extractAllToAsync callback and Promise forms). No test exercises a malformed DEFLATE stream over any async entry point.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the 'error' listener at the zipEntry.js call site only (or wrap that call in try/catch) and map every stream error to Utils.Errors.BAD_CRC, leaving inflateAsync's callback contract, the sync throw path and the deflate mirror untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The async chain also drops other synchronous throws from decompress() (missing password, unknown method) - noted as O8 routes only because they share the same sink; broader crash-hardening of adm-zip's async API is outside this advisory.
unverified: Repo size not measurable without a shell; all 20-odd source files are small (adm-zip.js 995 lines, zipFile.js 457, zipEntry.js 391, util/ methods/ headers/ each a few hundred), so source is far under 5 MB, but binary test fixtures under test/assets were not sized.
Latest release for O8 was given as 'none', so present_in_latest is unknown for every route.

Whether a malformed DEFLATE payload can be delivered to the write-side deflate stream (methods/deflater.js) was reasoned from code, not executed; the route is listed for structure, not triggerability.
